gates.label: G2
gates.title: Determinism, bit-identical within platform and version
gates.class_meaning: recovery by code in this repository -- self-consistency only
gates.claim: The implementation is self-consistent: one seed gives one output. Says nothing about whether that output resembles EEG.
gates.detail: 5 seed(s) generated twice each, 2 epoch(s), state n3; capped from 6 seeds, 1 not run

gates.label: G2~null
gates.title: Determinism null -- different seeds must differ
gates.class_meaning: recovery by code in this repository -- self-consistency only
gates.claim: Catches a seed that is not actually threaded through, and channels that share a substream. Says nothing about the quality of the randomness.
gates.detail: 5 seeds -> 5 distinct digests; 21 channels all distinct

gates.label: G4
gates.title: Respiration-chi off-frequency null
gates.class_meaning: recovery by code in this repository -- self-consistency only
gates.threshold: PAIRED per seed. Detection arm: depth(f1) wi...
gates.claim: The only check that the filter demonstration measures coupling rather than leakage from a tilt filter modulated at the respiratory rate. Class C -- we wrote the estimator -- and still the most important gate in Tier 0.
gates.detail: detection 12/12 (p=0.00024), selectivity 12/12 (p=0.00024); median depth f1=0.2772 vs f2=0.0391, ratio 7.09x. Injects g4_fixture_chi_mod_depth=2, 13x the shipped depth: says nothing about whether the SHIPPED coupling is recoverable. Runner supplied 6 seed(s); extended to g4_n_seeds=12 because the sign test's smallest achievable p is 2^-n and at n=6 one flipped seed would decide the gate.

gates.label: G4~null
gates.title: Respiration–χ leakage null — respiration at f₂ must not reach χ̂
gates.class_meaning: recovery by code in this repository -- self-consistency only
gates.threshold: Exact binomial sign test on the paired per-s...
gates.claim: Establishes that respiratory leakage into χ̂ is not gross. ABSENCE OF EVIDENCE: a paired sign test at this n cannot resolve a small leak, and the measured effect is 0.2% of the null median. Says nothing about the estimator's behaviour at other frequencies.
gates.detail: f2 5/12 (p=0.77, 1.000x, effect 0.0000 < floor); f2-f1 7/12 (p=0.77, 1.001x, effect 0.0010 < floor); f2+f1 7/12 (p=0.77, 0.999x, effect 0.0009 < floor). Mechanism (a) injects resp_artifact_amp ~5-25 uV at f2. Largest paired effect 0.0010 against the estimator's detection floor chi_est_mdd_resp = 0.048: leakage must be BOTH consistent (p < 0.05) and at least that large, because a paired sign test detects direction rather than magnitude. ABSENCE OF EVIDENCE either way -- this bounds leakage below the floor, it does not show it is zero.

gates.label: G6
gates.title: Topography, structural argmax
gates.class_meaning: recovery by code in this repository -- self-consistency only
gates.threshold: argmax over electrodes matches the topo_expe...
gates.claim: Tests the PROJECTION FILE against an expectation held independently in the registry. Reading the expectation from the file being tested would make this a check that argmax works.
gates.detail: spindle_fast -> C3 (ok, expected one of C3/C4/Cz); spindle_slow -> Fz (ok, expected one of F3/Fz/F4); kc -> Fz (ok, expected one of Fz/F3/F4); alpha -> Pz (ok, expected one of O1/O2/Pz). alpha posterior/frontal ratio inf (gate_alpha_ratio gt 3) RECORDED ONLY -- that row is invented and routed to T1-M2, so it does not decide this verdict. 1 seed: the weights are a data file, identical across seeds.

metric.unit: generators with argmax in the expected set

gates.label: G6~null
gates.title: Topography null — a mis-centred projection must fail every comparison
gates.class_meaning: recovery by code in this repository -- self-consistency only
gates.threshold: argmax over electrodes matches the topo_expe...
gates.claim: Confirms G6 reads the projection file and compares it against an independent expectation, rather than comparing the file to itself. Says nothing about whether the topographies are the right SHAPE — only that they are centred somewhere the literature agrees with, and that moving them breaks the gate.
gates.detail: transposed topographies (spindle_fast<->kc, alpha<->spindle_slow): 4/4 comparisons broke. spindle_fast -> Fz (left C3/C4/Cz); spindle_slow -> Pz (left F3/Fz/F4); kc -> C3 (left Fz/F3/F4); alpha -> Fz (left O1/O2/Pz)

gates.label: G5
gates.title: AASM N3 criterion
gates.class_meaning: recovery by code in this repository -- self-consistency only
gates.claim: POSITIVE ARM IS RECORD-ONLY (D9). Post-calibration this is largely a regression check on the amplitude relationship. It is NOT evidence that our N3 resembles real N3. The null carries the discriminative weight.
gates.detail: pass fraction 0.44 over 6 held-out seed(s) x 6 epochs; calibration seed 20260728 excluded; snr_nominal = 3.4836158752441406 dB. RECORD-ONLY: no threshold on this fraction exists that would not be invented.

gates.label: G5~null
gates.title: AASM N3 null -- N2 must fail, and N3 at -6 dB must fail
gates.class_meaning: recovery by code in this repository -- self-consistency only
gates.claim: Carries G5's verdict. Catches a criterion that everything passes -- which is not a criterion. Says nothing about whether our N3 resembles real N3.
gates.detail: N3 0.44 vs N2 0.00 (ok) and vs N3-6dB 0.03 (ok), 6 seed(s) x 6 epochs

gates.label: G1a
gates.title: chi round-trip, knee mode over 1-45 Hz
gates.class_meaning: recovery by an external, independently authored, published tool
gates.claim: Records the recovery error distribution for chi and k. Sets no tolerance at Tier 0; the tolerance is derived at T1-M2 from specparam bias and variance at our SNR and window.
gates.detail: Pz, 10 epochs x 6 seeds. [rem] injected χ=2.100: err +0.398 (IQR 0.045), knee 20.0 Hz -> 16.8 Hz | [n3] injected χ=3.400: err -1.206 (IQR 0.085), knee OUT OF BAND by design (1.00 Hz), unrecoverable in 2/6 fits. RECORD-ONLY: no tolerance exists and none may be derived from this spread. A DIFFERENT QUANTITY from G1b — never differenced against it.

metric.unit: χ recovery error, knee mode 1–45 Hz (rem)

gates.label: G1a~null
gates.title: χ recovery null — white noise must return χ ≈ 0 and no spurious knee
gates.class_meaning: recovery by an external, independently authored, published tool
gates.claim: Checks the harness's own PSD-and-fit path against a signal whose answer is known analytically. Says NOTHING about whether our generator's chi is right, nor about the recovery error the gate records — it is a wiring check, and the gate it guards is record-only.
gates.detail: white noise, 12 seeds x 300 s, MEANS tested (not per-seed): chi_hat +0.0015 +/- 0.0033 (|mean| < 0.1 ok), knee parameter -0.0897 (|mean| < 1.0 ok). Bounds are numerical resolution of 'returned zero', NOT the recovery tolerance the gate is missing; that stays absent until T1-M2. Synthetic white noise, so this checks the PSD-and-fit path, not the generator.

gates.label: G1b
gates.title: chi round-trip, fixed mode over 30-45 Hz
gates.class_meaning: recovery by an external, independently authored, published tool
gates.claim: A DIFFERENT quantity from G1a, not a second estimate of the same one. Its bias is structural and originates in the modelled 20 Hz knee, so its magnitude is a function of the invented k_* rows -- not evidence of comparability with published narrowband exponents.
gates.detail: Pz, 10 epochs x 6 seeds. [rem] injected χ=2.100: err -0.527 (IQR 0.286) | [n3] injected χ=3.400: err -1.332 (IQR 0.117). The bias is EXPECTED and kept: a fixed-mode fit across the modelled knee is what the published narrowband exponents were fitted with. Its magnitude is set by the invented knee_freq_* rows, so it is reproduced in form but not in mechanism. RECORD-ONLY. A DIFFERENT QUANTITY from G1a — never differenced against it.

metric.unit: χ recovery error, fixed mode 30–45 Hz (rem)

gates.label: G1b~null
gates.title: Narrowband chi null — white noise must return chi ~= 0 over 30–45 Hz
gates.class_meaning: recovery by an external, independently authored, published tool
gates.claim: Checks the fixed-mode fit path against a known-zero signal, and MEASURES the estimator's noise floor over 30–45 Hz. That floor exceeds the chi spacing between adjacent states, which constrains what any narrowband comparison can claim.
gates.detail: white noise, 12 seeds x 300 s, MEAN tested (not per-seed): chi_hat -0.0246 +/- 0.0674 (|mean| < 0.1 ok). PER-SEED sd 0.234 over only 0.176 decades of leverage — larger than the chi spacing between adjacent states in the registry, so no state ordering is supportable from narrowband chi on a single 300 s record (Finding 14, constrains P10). Synthetic white noise: this checks the fit path, not the generator.

metric.unit: chi_hat on white noise, 30-45 Hz (should be ~ 0)

gates.label: G3
gates.title: Spindle detection, F1 vs inclusion threshold
gates.class_meaning: recovery by an external, independently authored, published tool
gates.claim: Records the agreement curve. Sets no pass band: our ground truth has no label noise, so a realistic generator should score ABOVE the human ceiling, and forcing F1 down would mean injecting events too marginal to be spindles.
gates.detail: n2 @ Cz, 20 epochs x 6 seeds, median 34 injected vs 16 detected. All-event median F1 0.569. RECORD-ONLY: no acceptance tolerance exists. Quality stratification is unavailable; the former random prominence field is now an explicitly arbitrary inclusionTag.

metric.unit: F1 vs YASA, all injected events included

gates.label: G3~null
gates.title: Spindle null — the same background without spindles must not be detected as spindles
gates.class_meaning: recovery by an external, independently authored, published tool
gates.threshold: YASA run on the same background with graphoe...
gates.claim: Attributes YASA's detections to the injected events rather than to the background, by a paired contrast on a bit-identical background. Says nothing about whether the spindles look right — only that the detector is not firing on the noise.
gates.detail: n2 @ Cz, 20 epochs x 6 seeds, bit-identical background. median detections 16 with events vs 0 with them suppressed, against 34 injected. paired 6/6 (p=0.016, ok); false positives 0.000 of injected (< 0.2 ok). 'False-positive rate near zero' is not testable as written — no value of 'near' exists that would not be invented — so the paired contrast carries the claim and the raw counts are printed for a reader who wants to apply their own bound.

metric.unit: YASA detections on background with spindles suppressed
